internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rate in Checkout Service Due to Payment Service Issue
internal.body:
At 12:13 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified a high error rate (25%) in the payment service caused by invalid token errors, flagged as paymentFailure. This was confirmed as the root cause affecting checkout service errors.

Actions taken included disabling the paymentFailure flag at 12:33 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery with error rates dropping to normal levels (0.2%). The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Key timeline:
- 12:13:49: Alert received for checkout service error rate
- 12:33:36: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection
- 12:33:42: Flag disabled after approval
- 12:33:42: Recovery verified with normalized error rates

Lessons learned and action items are documented to prevent recurrence.

external.body: Between 12:13 and 12:33 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. The issue was identified and resolved within 20 minutes, restoring normal service. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
